utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already. If you need anything carried over, I’m headed that way later.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Ira. If you’re going anyway, I may take you up on that and bring my small box of broken lamps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, bring it by and I’ll make sure it gets there safely. I’m glad folks are pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive—what do you need from me again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just your old phone, charger, or any spare cables you’re not using. If you’ve got broken gadgets too, I can sort through them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got an old charger and a couple spare cables I can bring by. Maybe one busted phone too, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m trying to keep the logistics tidy. Let me double-check the timing and drop-off details before we do anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just let me know the confirmed time and drop-off spot when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m glad we’re doing that; I can help however you need, as long as you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren—right now we mainly need tools, spare parts, and any extra hands for sorting donations. I’ll make a little list and bring it by soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, Cleo—once you bring the list, I’ll check my shed for tools and see what I can gather. I might need a reminder or two, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, sure — I think it’s this Saturday near the community center, and we’re collecting tools, paint, and any small repair supplies. If you want, I can double-check the flyer too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Please double-check the flyer, and let me know the exact time and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Need me to pitch in anywhere?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey, no worries—it's going pretty well so far. If you could help sort the donated tools and point folks toward the sign-in table, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—happy to help. I’ll sort the tools and direct people to the sign-in table now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam—could you help sort donations and hand out tools to folks who need them?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can sort the donations and hand out tools. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard where the repair drive is set up yet—do you know the location?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the school notices and let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. If you find it, just let me know where it’s being set up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community hall. It’s really picking up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear! I’ll spread the word and swing by with anything extra I can find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn! If you spot any old screws, paint, or a working drill, they’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, how’s the repair drive going—did we get enough volunteers yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not quite yet, but we’ve got a few people signed up. I’m still checking with a couple more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how many more do you need before you can start?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few folks and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. Please let me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll talk to a few neighbors and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help get the repair drive organized. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Could you help me make a simple list of the broken things and who might be able to fix each one?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll start a simple list with each broken item and a likely helper for it. If you tell me what’s broken, I’ll sort the rest out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—people are bringing all kinds of tools and spare parts. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Please let me know if they set a clear time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as they nail down the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what do you still need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—mostly the leaky faucet and that loose porch step still need fixing. I’ve been telling folks we could use one more hand if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can help with that—happy to take the faucet if you’ve got the parts. Just point me to the porch step too and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive if you still need hands. Just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really kind of you, Rey. I could use the help—thank you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just tell me where you need me, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mostly I need the drop-off spot confirmed and a rough count of what you can haul. Once I know that, I can line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can confirm the drop-off spot at my garage, and I can haul a small load—maybe a few boxes and a chair or two.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive. Want me to help spread the word to the other folks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please—that’d help a lot. Could you share the date and let people know to bring only what’s on the list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the date and remind everyone to bring only the items on the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ve been a bit out of it, but I can help if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Noah—could you bring your toolbox and a roll of duct tape if you have them? We’ll put them to good use.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—I’ll grab my toolbox and look for some duct tape before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive got a nice turnout—folks really showed up for it. Did they end up getting enough help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, seems like they did pretty well—good turnout and plenty of hands. I’m glad folks pitched in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear. I’m glad the neighborhood came through for them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort tools and carry supplies. Just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Leo—please start by sorting the tools by type, then help me carry the paint and boxes to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics—do we know when the repair drive starts and where people should bring things?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good question—let me check the details and get back to you. If you hear anything, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything about the start time or drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I can spread the word around the block right away and put up a few invites too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Quinn—thank you. If you can mention we’re especially looking for tools and spare parts, that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll make sure people know we need tools and spare parts. I’ll get the invites out today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye. I was thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9, if that works around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 should work for me. I can help line things up around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can start organizing the repair drive list and spread the word to the block. Let me know what you need from me first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — could you help gather names of folks who need repairs and what the issues are? I’ll keep an eye out for anything I hear around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll start a quick list and check in with a few neighbors today. I’ll send you names and repair needs as I hear them.
